### Love for the Penitent
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/love-for-the-penitent
Passage: 2 Corinthians 2:5-8
Points:
- Paul instructed the Corinthian church to welcome back an offender who had undergone discipline and repented.
- The proper goal of Christian discipline is reconciliation and restoration, never retribution.
- Withholding forgiveness from a repentant believer risks drowning them in excessive grief and despair.
- When an offender demonstrates genuine sorrow over their sin, the community must offer comfort rather than continued rebuke.
- Believers are called to actively reaffirm their love and stand ready to forgive those who turn from wrongdoing.
